en.title: Participant and Bearing Management
en.excerpt: Operational guidance organizes participants, monitors status, and sets qualifying pads.
en.content:
View Participant List

The event dashboard displays a list of participants per category along with registration/payment status. Use filters to make monitoring easier.

Set Pad Placement

The committee can set assignment targets manually or automatically. Once final, perform an internal lock so that there are no sudden changes during the session.

Deployment Strategy

  • Make sure the distribution of participants is even according to category and shooting distance.
  • Avoid placing participants from the same region or community on one pad if regulations require equal distribution.
  • Make sure the session schedule fits the field capacity and number of field officers.
  • Re-check before qualifying scoring begins.

id.title: Manajemen Peserta dan Bantalan
id.excerpt: Panduan operasional menata peserta, memantau status, dan mengatur bantalan kualifikasi.
id.content:
Melihat Daftar Peserta

Dashboard event menampilkan daftar peserta per kategori beserta status registrasi/pembayaran. Gunakan filter untuk memudahkan monitoring.

Atur Penempatan Bantalan

Panitia dapat mengatur target assignment secara manual atau otomatis. Setelah final, lakukan lock internal agar tidak terjadi perubahan mendadak saat sesi berjalan.

Strategi Penempatan

  • Pastikan distribusi peserta merata sesuai dengan kategori dan jarak tembak.
  • Hindari penempatan peserta dari asal daerah atau komunitas yang sama pada satu bantalan jika regulasi mengharuskan pemerataan.
  • Pastikan jadwal sesi sesuai kapasitas lapangan dan jumlah petugas lapangan.
  • Lakukan re-check sebelum scoring kualifikasi dimulai.
